items.t: Caterpillar (CAT) Completes Ultra Low Methane Field Trial For Remote Gas Compression
items.sum: Caterpillar (NYSE:CAT) reported a successful field trial of a large horsepower gas compression system with ultra low methane emissions. The trial, conducted with Phoenix Service Partners, targeted remote natural gas compression operations without relying on grid connectivity. Field results indicated materially lower methane and other harmful emissions compared with conventional gas compression set

items.t: Caterpillar Sinks 11% in a Week to a New 52-Week Low. Is the Selling Overdone?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysCaterpillar fell 11% in the past week to a new 52-week low, about half its June high, as the AI-infrastructure sell-off also hit Vertiv and Bloom Energy. Caterpillar had no bad news of its own, and management told a Bernstein event it sees a favorable 2027.

items.t: Caterpillar’s 35% 3-Month Downturn: This Sell-Side Firm Predicts 90% Returns From Here With Another Close Behind
items.sum: Caterpillar posted record backlog and still lost a third of its value in three months while Deere and CNH held firm. Two firms say the damage is overdone, but one number in January could prove them wrong.

items.t: Caterpillar Has Lost 44% Since June Despite “Strong Order Rates and a Record Backlog”
items.sum: Key TakeawaysCaterpillar has lost about 44% of its market value since its June 30 peak, even after third-quarter sales rose 17% to a record $20. 7 billion.

items.t: Caterpillar CEO Joe Creed joins Walmart board of directors
items.sum: Walmart named Caterpillar CEO Joe Creed to its board of directors this week.
